patch: Miss, you're awake.
I'm glad to be in your company again, Miss.
Miss, let's do this.
Miss, judging from your reaction, you must have found a useful memory.
Be careful... Even if the head of the Lotophagists has never shown their true identity before, we shouldn't trust this person so easily.

, since our interests are aligned right now, it's better for us to do as she says. Besides, she knows about my past... Even though I'm not able to elaborate much, I can tell you that she has reasons to fear me.
Well... In that case, Miss, please go ahead.
Miss, I will observe her reaction based on your question to determine whether she is being truthful.
Miss...
Good work, Miss and... Professor Anaxa.
Miss, so many unexpected things happened on our journey to the Grove... We truly had no intention of putting you in danger, let alone face the black tide head on...
Speaking of Thanatos... Miss, there is something else I wish to verify with you.
...I'm curious why you weren't affected by my power, Miss?
Miss, you must be tired after being on the move these past few days. Please set aside the tragedy at the Grove for now and rest for the day.
Miss... May everything go well for you and Mem.
Miss... I'm sorry but I'm not sure what I should say to help calm your nerves.
Miss, I'm right here.
Miss, if my abrupt behavior just now offended you, I hope that you can forgive me.
But... Miss, would you be willing to let me try again? This time, I'll increase the area of contact slightly. Perhaps the result might be different this time...

It was me, I was a little too hasty. Don't worry, Miss. Although we currently have no leads, I will do my best to search for the whereabouts of Thanatos, bring back their Coreflame, and personally return to you... the life that you have lost too soon.
I'm here. Her life hangs by a thread, I must ask you to refrain from taking any unnecessary steps.
It's a matter of uncovering the truth about the Death Titan — and her survival...
I will wait for you. This matter is of great consequence... and Miss should hear the entire story from beginning to end.
Miss, are you ready now?
I will wait for you. This matter is of great consequence... and Miss should hear the entire story from beginning to end.
I've already searched for so long, I'm willing to try one more time. While we converse, her life is also slowly slipping away...
The Titan could be very near. I cannot let this chance slip by. Besides... someone has to make this trip to bring back Miss 's soul.
I decline. If we don't find the Death Titan, her soul will...
It's not about the value of the reward. If we don't find the Death Titan, her soul will...
On the day that Oronyx's Trial ended, you must have had many questions.
We must pursue her.
You don't have to describe it like that, Miss...
Miss, please fight them with caution...

The first time I wore a dress personally made by Lady Aglaea... the first time I went for a walk with Lady Tribbie, Lady Trianne, and Lady Trinnon... the first time I enjoyed the night breeze and looked up at the stars with Miss Hyacine... the first time I took care of dromases with the Trailblazer...
I have a feeling that soon, this gift of yours will become the key to saving Miss's life.
So, let's give our Coreflame to her and have her take it back to the mortal realm. Give humanity back their cycle of life and death.
Perhaps it is fate, once again fulfilling its own design. Or perhaps it is the laws from beyond the sky, so familiar to you, that intertwined our fates long ago...
Miss Cyrene has spoken of you often to me. Though we never met in this life, I believe... there's a kind of warmth that can transcend time itself.
Goodbye.
Thank you. My own path... has finally come to a gentle end.
Miss.
Perhaps you remember, Lord Mydei. In that lifetime when you traveled with her, you once told me...
Looks like they are waking up.
Miss, why don't you go say hi to them?
If you're worried, feel free to check everything out yourself, Miss.
Miss, I'm truly sorry for sneaking into your bath without permission...
Miss? Are you feeling alright?
Miss, could you please step forward? Oronyx seems to be calling out for you.
Miss, please consider carefully...
I'll stay with her to ensure her safety.
Miss, are you feeling alright?
Miss, are you feeling alright? You were—
What did they say, Miss?
Before we leave, I'd like to check with Lady Aglaea again. Do you mind waiting for me, Miss?
Everything's set now. Let's head out, Miss.
I understand how you feel, Miss. But right now, we must head to another battlefield.
Let's go, Miss. We will unravel Nikador's secrets together.
Miss... Much as we're in a memory of the past, impulse buying is still an undesirable behavior.
May I take a look at that weapon, Miss?
I thought you'd be the kind to make impulsive purchases, Miss. , but you've certainly proven me wrong.
...I've seen enough. Let's go, Miss.
Please wait, Miss. It's best not to go there yet...
Let's run through everything we know so far, Miss.
Miss, this might be our chance...! We can enter the city with him.
Have faith, Miss... Lord Phainon and Lord Mydei are still fighting. We must match their unwavering resolve.
Please keep it together, Miss.
Let's clear this trial together, Miss.
Let's recover the miracle from the tome, Miss.
I... I'm fine, Miss. There's no need to worry.
Calm yourself, Miss... I believe he has no ill intent toward us.
I'm fine... Miss.
Go with the rest, Miss. I will catch up with you later. I would like to talk to Lord Gnaeus again... one last time.
I—I'm sorry, but I can feel the power surging through me...!
Miss, and Miss Tohsaka! Sorry, we were so engrossed we didn't see you...

We're really, really happy that we could go on this sightseeing tour full of surprises, and have so many of our wishes granted all at once. At the end of this journey, there could be nothing better than sharing our joy with Miss Tohsaka and the Trailblazer.
As well as personally awarding Miss a medal.
